name: Dark-Mode Developer Tool
summary: Near-black surfaces, 1px hairline borders, one saturated accent, a monospace for data and keyboard hints on every action. It came from code editors and terminals and now defines software for engineers.

philosophy.core_thesis: A tool for experts is a dense, calm, dark instrument: show a lot, keep it quiet and make everything reachable from the keyboard.
design_principles: Use a near-black ground (#0B0B0E) and 2 or 3 surface steps of 4% to 8% lightness each; no pure black and no pure white.
Draw every border as a 1px hairline in white at 8% to 12% opacity; panels have a radius of 6px to 8px.
Set one accent colour (indigo #5A66E8 or similar) and use it on less than 5% of the surface: focus, selection and the primary button.
Set UI text at 13px to 14px in a neutral sans and all data, ids and code in a monospace at 12px to 13px.
Show a keyboard hint in a 1px bordered key cap (radius 4px, 11px text) next to each main action; offer a command palette on Cmd+K.
Give every row a height of 32px to 40px and keep lists dense; separate rows by hairline, not by space.
Use motion of 100ms to 200ms for state changes only, with no entrance effects on content.
anti_patterns: Pure black (#000000) or pure white text
Large rounded cards and thick borders
Colourful backgrounds and more than one accent colour
Decorative illustration in the product view
Drop shadows with large blur on panels
Light themes as the only option

layout.grid_mechanics: A sidebar of 240px to 280px and a content area on a 4px grid; panels split by hairlines; rows of 32px to 40px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 15% to 25% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 12, 16 and 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left; numbers right-aligned in a monospace; actions in a toolbar at the top right.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 6px to 8px radius, a 1px hairline border and no shadow; key caps with a 4px radius.

font_pairings.note: One neutral UI face for text; set data and code in JetBrains Mono through --font-mono.
A matched sans and mono family.
A technical pairing with a clear voice.

typography.tracking: Display takes -0.02em; body stays at 0; small labels take +0.02em.
hierarchy_rules: Use three weights: regular (400), medium (500) and semibold (600).
Set headings in sentence case in medium weight.
Set ids, hashes and numbers in the monospace with tabular figures.

color.palette_structure: Near-black ground, grey surfaces, off-white text and one accent.
color.contrast_rules: Text holds at least 12:1 on void; muted text holds at least 4.5:1; the accent carries focus and primary buttons.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, opaque, matt surfaces; steps of 4% to 8% lightness show depth; a faint radial glow of the accent at 6% opacity is allowed behind the hero only.
color.light_and_shadow: No cast shadows; elevation is a lighter surface and a hairline; a 1px top highlight of white at 6% on cards.

materiality.surface_simulation: A dark terminal and code editor, shown as flat tonal surfaces.
materiality.border_rules: 1px hairline in white at 8% to 12% opacity on all panels, inputs and key caps.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur on panels except a 12px blur on overlays. Elevation is shown by lighter tone and hairline, not by shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons with a 1.5px stroke, round caps and round joins at 16px; one family only; icons sit next to text and have no container.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Product screenshots of the real tool in dark mode, with an accent glow; abstract line diagrams.

motion.transition_physics: Quick, quiet state moves: panels slide 8px and fade in 150ms; lists update with no delay; the command palette opens in 120ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts a row to the raised surface and shows its key hint; active state shows a 1px accent ring.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels focus, speed and the calm of a tool made by experts.

avoid_when: The audience is a general consumer.
The brand must feel warm or playful.
The page is long-form editorial reading.

modifiers.how: Switch to a white ground and ink text; keep the 1px hairlines and one accent.
Add 16px backdrop blur to overlays and a colour glow behind panels.
Replace hairlines with 3px black borders and hard shadows; keep the density.

pack.why: A thin, even 1.5px line at 16px that sits beside 13px text without weight.

ground.why: Developer tools sit on a dark canvas with a dot grid and a glow of the brand colour.

tailwind.classes: rounded-md bg-[#5A66E8] px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-[#4853D6]
